crossRefs.note: My son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.
translations.bsb: So in the morning Balaam got up, saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.
translations.kjv: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
translations.asv: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
